revision_notes: Map final2 evidence predates later source coordination and export-only compatibility fixes. Wafer graphics code is identical to final; each report retains its actual source hashes.

Linked-final3 matrices verify source-pending protection and identical-source replay. Later changes only restore immediate precision export and completed-overlay button availability; the final targeted and full runs validate those changes.
No randomization/interleaving of before and after groups. Same cycle numbers are descriptive pairs on the same machine/input/runtime.
Initial combined matrix stopped on a real false-dirty assertion in small-linked-final2; this evidence is retained, not substituted as a passing result.
An additional red test reproduced cancellation of a Map job whose child table was already current; final matched-frame branch replays that draw.
The visual-before probe initially used an unsupported pyqtgraph wrapper keyword. Only the QA capture was corrected to the Qt base renderer; before2/final2 passed.
The first full run (1263 tests / 1184.451s) found two export-precision behavior regressions, one old worker-only waiter, and two unchanged timing gates. All three full logs are retained.

Final export-only overlay flush restores the existing immediate precision contract without allowing stale source or pending graphics exports; 39 targeted tests passed before the necessary final full rerun.
The Map resize waiter now waits for completed graphics within the unchanged 15-second deadline; all original zoom/scroll and source assertions remain.

Second full: 1263 tests / 1177.658s, 1260 passed, two unchanged timing failures and one fixed-250ms font-layout test waiter error. The test was corrected to wait for complete graphics; all 54 Array/precision/lifecycle tests passed in 94.043s with all PNG/SVG/PDF assertions.

A subsequent red test reproduced a real source-pause/queued-global-precision race: completed current graphics could retain disabled export buttons. Five lines restore availability only after current valid overlays finish. All 62 targeted tests passed in 111.081s.

The original no-third-full plan was explicitly withdrawn because that new production fix required a necessary third complete regression, not to seek a lucky timing pass. full-last.log is the authoritative latest result.
limits: Full end-to-end Ctrl+V/Z/Y is not below 300ms. Correlation retained rendering, original workbook processing, RBF work and viewport rasterization remain.
Small heavy-plot completion gets slower while GUI callback spans drop sharply; light controls retain the original source shortcut.
Map style completion has a small positive overhead; do not call this phase faster.
Memory snapshots and lifetime peak WS do not prove absence of leaks. Retired panels/layers were separately checked with weakrefs and explicit deferred deletion.
Clearing axes is not evidence that an already-created Agg renderer buffer immediately returns to the OS. Long repeated exported-canvas close behavior is not a new audited baseline.
A timing failure stops its later assertions in that run; targeted/native evidence is reported separately, never counted as full-suite green.
